inputs.label: Your Dave Mirra Freestyle BMX 2 disc image (USA, SLUS-20159, version 1.00): a .bin with its .cue, an .iso, or a .chd.

prepare.label: Translating the game's code from your disc and building it

options.label: Download the build tools and the project's source
options.note: From GitHub and python.org, kept in the game's folder: this project's source, the llvm-mingw C compiler and a small Python (about 200 MB).

options.label: Download the project's source
options.note: From GitHub, kept in the game's folder (a few MB). The game is built with your system's C compiler, Python 3, SDL2 and OpenGL/EGL development files (Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install gcc python3 libsdl2-dev libgl-dev libegl-dev).

settings.label: Internal resolution
settings.help: How sharp the 3D is drawn. 1x is the PS2's own; 2x to 4x also smooth the edges.

settings.label: Window mode
settings.help: F11 or Alt+Enter switches while playing.

settings.label: Window size
settings.help: Auto is 1280x960 (1280x720 with widescreen), made smaller to fit the screen.

settings.label: Widescreen
settings.help: A wider 3D view shown at 16:9. Menus and on-screen text are stretched.

settings.label: Picture filter
settings.help: How the picture is enlarged to the window.

settings.label: V-Sync
settings.help: Shows frames in step with a 60 or 120 Hz screen, which is smoother.

settings.label: V-Sync on two-chip laptops
settings.help: When another graphics chip drives the screen: Off may tear, On may stutter. Needs V-Sync on.

settings.label: Intro movies
settings.help: The start-up movies. The Acclaim and Z-Axis logos still show for 2 seconds each.

settings.label: Volume
settings.help: The game's sound in percent: music, effects and movie sound.

settings.label: Gamepad
settings.help: An Xbox-style gamepad as the PS2 pad: A is Cross, B Circle, X Square, Y Triangle.

settings.label: Vibration
settings.help: Also needs Vibration: On in the game's Options > Controller.

settings.label: Player 2
settings.help: For Multiplayer. With one gamepad, give it to player 2 and play player 1 on the keyboard.

settings.label: Keyboard
settings.help: Up to 2 keys per button. Escape also opens the game's menu, F11 and Alt+Return switch fullscreen. The mouse wheel does nothing yet.

actions.label: Memory card
actions.help: The game's saves, in the folder mc0.

exit_codes.3: The game reached code that was not recompiled yet. Please open an issue on the project's GitHub page and say what you were doing.
exit_codes.4: The game ran into an instruction the recompiler doesn't handle. Please open an issue on the project's GitHub page with the log.
exit_codes.6: The game's graphics thread got a command it does not know. Please open an issue on the project's GitHub page with the log.
exit_codes.5: OpenGL 3.3 could not start. Update your graphics driver; on a laptop with two graphics chips, set the game to the dedicated one in Windows' graphics settings. On Linux, install your distribution's Mesa or GPU vendor driver.
exit_codes.7: Your disc image is missing, or it is not Dave Mirra Freestyle BMX 2 (USA, SLUS-20159, version 1.00). Pick your copy again on the game's page.

looks.reason: The game is started by the project's own program, so the filters can't reach it. Use the game's own Smooth filter and internal resolution.
